# Source-licence register

<!-- Generated by scripts/ci/licence-register.mjs from the source register seed in code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every data source the code can contact, with its permitted use, its risk rating, its status and the rule for showing its content. [DAT-120, DAT-124, BLD-040]

How to read this page:

- It is generated from the register rows that the database migrations seed. The live status can differ. Read the live status on System health, in Data controls.
- A source whose terms forbid our use is switched off unless you record a risk acceptance. [DAT-120]
- Content from a personal-use-only source is limited to derived numbers, headlines, links and our own summaries. [DAT-124]
- A source with "AI summaries allowed: no" is shown as headline and link only, with no model summary. [DAT-120]
- Re-check every source's terms on the first Saturday of each month (Ops checklist). [OPS-020]

## Owner dependencies

- ASX announcements (O-23): the risk acceptance date is pending Owner. Until you accept, the source stays pending and nothing contacts it.
- Yahoo Finance end-of-day prices (O-26): the risk acceptance date is pending Owner. Until you accept, the source stays pending and nothing contacts it.
- ASX listed-companies file (O-23b): the risk acceptance date is pending Owner. Until you accept, the source stays pending and nothing contacts it.
- Yahoo Finance delayed intraday quotes (O-26): the risk acceptance date is pending Owner. Until you accept, the source stays pending and nothing contacts it.
- Yahoo Finance end-of-day prices, India (.NS) (O-26): the risk acceptance date is pending Owner. Until you accept, the source stays pending and nothing contacts it.
- Yahoo Finance end-of-day prices, US (O-26): the risk acceptance date is pending Owner. Until you accept, the source stays pending and nothing contacts it.
- Terms URLs and last-checked dates are not recorded in the seed. The source evaluation and the monthly re-check fill them in the live register.

## India and US sources (written when a market is enabled)

- These rows are defined in `src/lib/market/seed/in/sources.mjs` and `src/lib/market/seed/us/sources.mjs` and are written to the register, with their status rows, when the Owner switches the market out of off (D-1128). No migration inserts them, so production holds none while India and the US are off.
- `enabled` = public statistics, the public holiday lists, EDGAR (free, fair-access terms, a declared contact required) and the manual files. `pending` = a fetched source whose terms are checked and which the Owner turns on. `disabled` = NSE and BSE announcements until the Owner accepts the terms risk (headline and link only, never a body, D-1125).
- A source whose robots.txt disallows automated clients is never requested; the polite client refuses it (D-1093, D-1132).

## Delayed-quote endpoint: facts and fallback (V2-I3, D-792)

- Request pattern (one per code): `GET https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/{CODE}.AX?interval=1m&range=1d`. The same host and path family as the end-of-day fetch (`scripts/fixtures/record-day.mjs` uses `/v8/finance/chart/` with `interval=1d`). The two scripts share the host but not the code; the fixture recorder is the reference for the payload shape.
- Status of the endpoint: unofficial, undocumented, no API key, no service-level promise, terms not recorded (see the Yahoo rows). The [VERIFY at build] marker is closed: the pattern above is the one the code uses and the parser tests (`tests/quotes`) pin the payload shape. It can change or be blocked without notice.
- Failure behaviour: HTTP 429 pauses both quote routes for `quote_pause_cooldown_min`; 5xx and network errors end the run. Nothing else contacts the host, and nothing is requested unless the source is accepted (D-398).
- Named fallback: none. The ASX delayed quote page is scrape-only, its terms forbid automated access, and it is not zero-cost-safe, so it is not a fallback and no second source is added. If the endpoint stops working the intraday watch and pick alerts go quiet and System Health shows the source as paused; the Owner can leave the source off. Any paid or licensed feed would be a new Owner decision with its own register row.
